import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0072 (a b c : ℝ) (h1 : a^2 + b^2 = c^2) (h2 : a^2 + c^2 = b^2) : a = 0 ∧ b = 0 ∧ c = 0 := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0072 (a b c : ℝ) (h1 : a^2 + b^2 = c^2) (h2 : a^2 + c^2 = b^2) : a = 0 ∧ b = 0 ∧ c = 0 := by
  have h3 : a^2 + b^2 + a^2 + c^2 = c^2 + b^2 by
    rw [h1, h2]
  have h4 : 2 * a^2 + b^2 + c^2 = b^2 + c^2 by
    rw [h3]
  have h5 : 2 * a^2 = 0 by
    rw [h4]
  have h6 : a^2 = 0 by
    rw [h5]
  have h7 : a = 0 by
    norm_num
  have h8 : b^2 + c^2 = 0 by
    rw [h1, h6]
  have h9 : b^2 = 0 ∧ c^2 = 0 by
    rw [h8]
  have h10 : b = 0 ∧ c = 0 by
    norm_num
  exact h7 :: h10
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0072 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0072 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0072

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0072
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0072
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
